purpose: Defines the logical data model of doc-link: information entities, identifiers, sources, relations, multiplicity, and the meaning and freshness of values, without specifying a physical schema.
summary: Model boundary: current actual files versus last confirmed index are separate information
Table of logical entities with identity, attributes, primary source and relations
Document information is stored once per document ID and shared across all keys
Confirmed ToC holds membership, references, reflected hashes, section entries and last check state
Multiplicity rules: a document may belong to many keys and have many reference records
Reverse references are derived only from scanned referrers
Sections identified by DLID at heading end; unassigned sections have no stable identity
Document ID differs from content hash; link path fixes change the hash
Reference check results are valid only for the recorded directory and time
tasks: Designing data structures for document information and ToC
Implementing storage of confirmed ToC and document information
Designing reference records and check results
Handling documents leaving the index scope
Deciding freshness semantics of reference check results
Designing section entries and section IDs
title: DES-003 論理データモデル
